releaseNotes: Cinematic per-title theming: every movie and TV title now pulls its own color palette from its artwork — the hero, accents, and page wash shift per title with a smooth first-frame fade, so the app feels tuned to what you're watching. Detail and browse refresh: redesigned hero, new list pages, and ranked search that puts the best match first. Subtitles upgraded: sidecar subtitle files, an auto-sync engine, and online subtitle search in the player. Playback hardening: more reliable embed watch sessions, episode correctness, and automatic provider switching when a source dies mid-play. Plus orientation-aware subtitle positioning (Low/Middle), path-form deep links with Android App Links, new MovieBox and Bing sources, HDHub download pages, and a redesigned square splash.
